description: Sardenya is a Korean range of cross-linked hyaluronic acid dermal fillers produced by RFBio. Built on non-animal HA with BDDE cross-linking, the line spans four viscoelastic grades (Implant, Shape, Deep, Fine) so a single brand covers superficial line correction through deep structural volumizing. Most variants include lidocaine for injection comfort.
howItWorks: Each syringe delivers a cross-linked HA gel that occupies tissue space and binds water to restore volume and hydration. Injection depth and indication are matched to each grade's particle size and G-prime (elastic modulus): firmer, higher-G' gels (Implant, Shape) are placed deep for projection and support, while softer, lower-G' gels (Fine) sit superficially for delicate lines.
composition: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid 24 mg/mL, non-animal origin, BDDE cross-linker, with 0.3% lidocaine in the lidocaine variants.
usageNotes: Follow standard HA handling: store refrigerated, equilibrate to room temperature before use, inject with aseptic technique and avoid intravascular placement. Match grade to plane and keep hyaluronidase available to dissolve HA in case of overcorrection or vascular compromise.
features: Four-grade viscoelastic system (Implant / Shape / Deep / Fine)
BDDE cross-linking for extended in-tissue residence
Manufactured in Korea to international quality standards
benefits: One brand covers fine-line to deep-volume indications, simplifying inventory
Predictable placement per grade supports reproducible clinical outcomes
Integrated lidocaine reduces need for separate anaesthetic
Reversible with hyaluronidase, aiding risk management
indications: Moderate to deep folds and nasolabial correction (Deep)
Facial contouring of nose, chin and cheeks (Shape)
Deep volume restoration and structural augmentation (Implant)

description: Youthfill is a Korean cross-linked hyaluronic acid filler series from RFBio, offered in three grades (Shape, Deep, Fine) that differ by degree of cross-linking rather than HA concentration. All variants use patented BDDE cross-linking at a uniform 24 mg/mL HA and include lidocaine, covering wrinkle correction, volume restoration and facial contouring.
howItWorks: The cross-linked HA gel adds volume and draws water into the dermis to smooth and plump tissue. Because HA concentration is held constant and viscoelasticity is tuned via cross-linking density, the firmer Shape grade is placed deep for sculpting while the softer Fine grade is delivered superficially for shallow lines, with depth governed by each grade's particle size and G-prime.
composition: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid 24 mg/mL, non-animal origin, BDDE cross-linked, with 0.3% lidocaine.
usageNotes: Standard HA protocol applies: refrigerate for storage, warm to room temperature before injection, use aseptic technique and aspirate/avoid vessels. Select grade by tissue plane and keep hyaluronidase on hand for correction or emergency dissolution.
features: Three cross-linking grades at a constant 24 mg/mL HA
benefits: Consistent HA load simplifies dosing logic across grades
Grade-based selection supports layered, plane-specific treatment
Built-in lidocaine streamlines the procedure
HA chemistry allows hyaluronidase reversibility
indications: Superficial wrinkles around eyes, lips and neck (Fine)
Nasolabial folds and lip modelling in the deep dermis (Deep)
Nose, chin and cheekbone contouring and volume (Shape)
General wrinkle correction and skin plumping

description: Misfill (marketed as Misfill+) is a Korean cross-linked hyaluronic acid dermal filler offered in three grades (Volume, Deep, Light) that differ by particle size and viscoelasticity. The HA is highly purified and each grade includes lidocaine, covering shallow crease correction, deep wrinkle filling and facial volumizing.
howItWorks: The cross-linked HA gel fills tissue and binds water to add volume and hydration. Grade selection follows particle size and G-prime: Volume uses medium-to-larger particles placed in deeper planes for contour and projection, Deep addresses mid-to-deep folds, and Light uses a softer gel for superficial lines and delicate areas.
composition: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid 24 mg/mL with 0.3% lidocaine, highly purified non-animal HA.
usageNotes: Apply general HA handling: cold-chain storage, room-temperature equilibration before injection, aseptic technique and avoidance of intravascular placement. Choose grade by depth and retain hyaluronidase for overcorrection or vascular events.
features: High-purity HA with low residual impurity claims
benefits: Grade range covers superficial to deep indications in one brand
Purity focus supports tolerability
Lidocaine reduces procedural discomfort
HA basis allows enzymatic reversal if needed
indications: Lip lines, tear troughs and shallow creases (Light)

description: Soonsufill is the Korean domestic brand of Jetema's cross-linked hyaluronic acid filler line, exported internationally as e.p.t.q. It is offered in three viscoelastic grades (S500, S300, S100) manufactured with Jetema's ZEEP (Zero Endotoxin and BDDE Entire Process) purification, spanning fine-line correction through deep volumizing, with lidocaine for comfort.
howItWorks: The cross-linked HA gel restores volume and binds water to hydrate and lift tissue. Grades are differentiated by consistency and G-prime: S500 is the firmest for deep structural placement and projection, S300 targets mid-to-deep wrinkles, and S100 is a low-density gel optimised for smooth flow into superficial lines and thin-skinned areas.
composition: Cross-linked non-animal hyaluronic acid with 0.3% lidocaine; viscoelasticity graded across S100, S300 and S500. Produced with ZEEP low-endotoxin, controlled-BDDE processing.
usageNotes: Use standard HA technique: refrigerated storage, room-temperature equilibration, aseptic injection and vessel avoidance. Match grade to plane; keep hyaluronidase available for correction or vascular compromise.
features: Optimised injection pressure in lower-density grades
Same platform as internationally distributed e.p.t.q.
benefits: Grade range covers fine lines to deep volume in one system
Low-endotoxin process supports a favourable safety profile
Smoother extrusion in S100 aids delicate, superficial work
HA chemistry permits hyaluronidase reversibility
indications: Crow's feet, perioral fine lines and tear troughs (S100)
Forehead, nasolabial folds and perioral/puppet lines (S300)

description: Yvoire is LG Chem's flagship cross-linked hyaluronic acid dermal filler line, formulated with proprietary HICE cross-linking that stabilises high-concentration, high-molecular-weight HA. The range includes Classic, Volume and Contour grades (with lidocaine-containing Plus versions) covering wrinkle correction, volume restoration and facial contouring.
howItWorks: HICE cross-linked HA gel occupies tissue and binds water to smooth wrinkles and restore volume, with monophasic gel structure aiding even distribution. Grade selection follows viscoelasticity and G-prime: Classic for wrinkle correction in the mid dermis, Volume for deeper volumizing, and Contour for firm structural sculpting.
composition: Highly cross-linked hyaluronic acid, non-animal, roughly 18-24 mg/mL depending on variant (e.g. Volume 22 mg/mL; Plus grades 20 mg/mL), with 3 mg/mL lidocaine in the Plus versions. HICE cross-linking with minimised BDDE.
usageNotes: Standard HA handling: cold-chain storage, room-temperature equilibration, aseptic technique and intravascular avoidance. Select grade by treatment plane and keep hyaluronidase on hand for correction or vascular emergencies.
features: Manufacturer with recognised international quality systems
benefits: Established global brand backing supports clinic confidence
HICE stabilisation targets durable volume retention
Grade range spans wrinkle correction to deep contouring
Reversible HA gel aids clinical risk management
indications: Fine to moderate wrinkles and folds (Classic)
Volume restoration in cheeks and mid-face (Volume)

description: Metoo Fill+ Point is the lidocaine-containing tier of Maypharm's Metoo Fill+ cross-linked hyaluronic acid filler line, built on a 3D HA cross-linking technology. It is offered in three grades (Volume, Deep, Light) matched to particle size, covering fine lines, deep folds and volumizing, with lidocaine added for a more comfortable procedure.
howItWorks: The cross-linked HA gel adds volume and binds water to hydrate and lift tissue. Grade and depth follow particle size and G-prime: Volume for deep-plane volumizing, Deep for moderate-to-deep folds, and Light for superficial fine lines, with the Point line's lidocaine easing injection.
composition: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid, non-animal origin, 3D cross-linking, with lidocaine in the Point (lidocaine) variants.
usageNotes: Follow standard HA protocol: refrigerated storage, room-temperature equilibration, aseptic technique and vessel avoidance. Select grade by plane and retain hyaluronidase for overcorrection or vascular compromise.
features: Easy tissue penetration to limit trauma
benefits: Integrated lidocaine improves patient comfort
Grade range covers superficial to deep indications
Smooth injectability supports even placement
HA basis allows hyaluronidase reversal
indications: Fine forehead, periorbital and perioral lines (Light)
Lips, nasolabial folds and marionette lines (Deep)

description: Rejeunesse is Daewoong's line of 100% cross-linked, high-density hyaluronic acid dermal fillers manufactured with UPHEC purification technology to reduce endotoxin levels. Offered in Fine, Deep and Shape grades with 0.3% lidocaine, it is a monophasic non-animal HA gel spanning hydration and fine-line work through deep contouring.
howItWorks: The cross-linked HA gel restores volume and binds water to smooth wrinkles and hydrate the dermis. Grade selection follows viscoelasticity and G-prime: the low-viscosity Fine gel is placed superficially for hydration and fine lines, Deep addresses medium wrinkles and lips, and the firm Shape grade is placed deep for chin, jawline and facial contouring.
composition: 100% cross-linked hyaluronic acid 24 mg/mL, non-animal origin, with 0.3% lidocaine hydrochloride; produced with UPHEC purification.
usageNotes: Standard HA handling applies: refrigerated storage, room-temperature equilibration, aseptic technique and intravascular avoidance. Match grade to injection plane and keep hyaluronidase available for correction or vascular emergencies.
benefits: Established pharma manufacturer supports clinic trust
Purification process targets a clean safety profile
Grade range covers hydration through deep contouring
HA gel is reversible with hyaluronidase

description: Metoo Fill+ is Maypharm's second-generation cross-linked hyaluronic acid dermal filler line, built on a 3D HA cross-linking technology for durable results. The base range is offered in three grades (Volume, Deep, Light) matched to particle size, covering fine lines, deep folds and facial volumizing; a separate 'Point' tier adds lidocaine.
howItWorks: The cross-linked HA gel adds volume and binds water to hydrate and lift tissue. Depth and indication follow particle size and G-prime: Volume for deep volumizing, Deep for moderate-to-deep folds, and Light for shallow lines and delicate areas.
composition: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid, non-animal origin, 3D cross-linking; base Metoo Fill+ variants are supplied without lidocaine (lidocaine available in the Point line).
usageNotes: Use standard HA technique: refrigerated storage, room-temperature equilibration, aseptic injection and vessel avoidance. When lidocaine-free, consider topical or local anaesthesia; keep hyaluronidase on hand for correction or vascular compromise.
features: Easy tissue penetration to minimise trauma
benefits: Grade range covers superficial to deep indications
Cross-linking aimed at extended durability
Lidocaine-free base option suits clinics preferring their own anaesthesia
HA basis allows hyaluronidase reversal
indications: Fine forehead, nasal-bridge and periorbital lines (Light)
Lips, nasolabial folds and forehead wrinkles (Deep)

description: Celosome is a Korean cross-linked hyaluronic acid dermal filler line made by ExoCoBio using HENM cross-linking and an eight-stage purification process to minimise residual BDDE, endotoxin and heavy metals. Offered in Implant, Strong, Mid and Soft grades at a uniform 24 mg/mL HA (most with lidocaine), it spans superficial correction through deep structural volumizing.
howItWorks: The cross-linked HA gel occupies tissue and binds water to restore volume and hydration. HENM cross-linking lets viscoelasticity be tuned per grade, so higher-G' gels (Implant, Strong) are placed deep for projection and structural support while softer gels (Soft) sit superficially for fine correction, with depth governed by particle size and G-prime.
composition: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid 24 mg/mL, non-animal origin, HENM cross-linking; most grades include 0.3% lidocaine.
usageNotes: Standard HA handling: refrigerated storage, room-temperature equilibration, aseptic technique and intravascular avoidance. Select grade by plane and retain hyaluronidase for overcorrection or vascular compromise.
features: Uniform 24 mg/mL HA across the line
benefits: Multi-grade line covers fine lines to deep volume
High-purity process supports tolerability
Consistent HA load simplifies dosing across grades
HA gel is reversible with hyaluronidase
